label: human-associated environment
definition: An environmental system determined by a human.
editors note: Requested by HabitatMech. Attested by BACDIVE, GOLD with 52129 upstream assertions across 1 source concept(s): Human. The habitat is the host clade, and it is the entire content of the concept: GOLD and BacDive both organise host-associated isolates by host, and every downstream anatomical path hangs off it. HabitatMech deliberately does not ground these to animal-associated environment, because every clade would then merge onto one record and the distinction the sources are making would be lost.
